issue: ELX4 — the R7 fabrications measured on 605 corpus files
note: Every forbid below was an emitted edge at HEAD, named here by its site. (1) `@spec require/import/alias(...)` is a TYPESPEC naming a function, not a directive: it published `references -> "[Path.t], require_opts"` (kernel/parallel_compiler.ex:278) and 22 siblings. (2) `alias :lists, as: MyList` glued the options into the module name (`references -> ":lists, as: MyList"`, alias_test.exs:18). (3) `%URI{uri | path: "/bar"}.path` and `%Point{}.foo_bar` published a struct EXPRESSION as a call target — the conviction sample validation/m60/target-spelling-register.json names for this lane. (4) `x.foo` is a field read and must not be a call. (5) `defmacro (..)` published a macro named `(` — EX-A15's own fix was dead on arrival. (6) `defmodule Module.concat(A, B)` published its own SOURCE LINE as a module name and a `%__MODULE__{}` inside it fabricated an `instantiates` target; the body must not attach to the enclosing module either. (7) `defmodule :"Elixir.Abs"` is absolute and must not be re-prefixed with its scope.
